title: JK Paper's Singhania elected chair of International Chamber of Commerce.
snippet: Harsh Pati Singhania, the chairman and managing director of JK Paper and director of the JK Organisation, has been officially elected as the new chair of the International Chamber of Commerce.

title: #WallessTaxCookies | Cross-border movement for goods under ATA Carnet is going paperless.
snippet: Starting from 1 June 2026, EU Member States, including Latvia, together with Norway, Switzerland and the UK, will begin introducing the new eATA Carnet System developed by the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC), gradually replacing paper-based ATA Carnets with digital solutions.

title: Digital trade that delivers: scaling the UK-Japan corridor.
snippet: Teesside University, the International Centre for Digital Trade and Innovation, and government stakeholders, in partnership with ICC United Kingdom, have published a new report highlighting how digitalisation can deliver faster, more efficient and more accessible trade between the UK and Japan.

title: TikTok and ICC launch "Digital Commerce Labs" to scalp Nigerian SMEs for global markets.
snippet: In a significant move to bridge the digital divide for local entrepreneurs, TikTok and the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) have announced the launch of Digital Commerce Labs.

title: Revitalising the multilateral trading system toolkit
snippet: ICC United Kingdom has launched Revitalising the multilateral trading system, a new advocacy toolkit setting out a clear call to action ahead of the 14th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Cameroon in March 2026.

title: ICC United Kingdom Unveils Ambitious Growth Plan

title: Etihad to pilot digital health pass on Paris route – Business Traveller

title: Preparing for the return of business travel in a post-Covid-19 world | TTGmice
